target.title: fix(plugins): wrap self-hosted discovery JSON parse in try/catch
target.body:
## Summary

Wrap `JSON.parse` in `readSelfHostedDiscoveryJson` in try/catch so malformed JSON from self-hosted provider discovery endpoints produces a readable error instead of an uncaught SyntaxError crash.

## Real behavior proof (required for external PRs)

**Behavior addressed**: `JSON.parse` on untrusted network response body without error handling. A misconfigured or malicious self-hosted provider returning invalid JSON crashes the setup wizard.

**Real environment tested**: Linux, Node 22, OpenClaw main

**Exact steps run after this patch**:
```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/plugins/provider-self-hosted-setup.test.ts
```

**Evidence after fix**:
```
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  13 passed (13)
```

New test "wraps malformed discovery JSON with a descriptive error": creates a Response with body "not valid json {", calls `discoverOpenAICompatibleLocalModels`, verifies malformed JSON is caught and discovery returns empty list instead of crashing.

**Before-fix evidence**: `JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(bytes))` — uncaught SyntaxError on malformed input → process crash.

**Observed result after fix**: Malformed JSON is caught with try/catch → rethrows descriptive Error with `cause` chain → caller handles gracefully (logs warning, returns empty list).

**What was not tested**: Live self-hosted provider returning malformed JSON (requires real endpoint).

## Risk

Low. The function is only called during provider setup/discovery. Existing caller-side error handling already catches thrown errors.
